correctness.rationale: For coordinate subspaces U=span(e_S),W=span(e_T), evolution multiplication gives UW=span{e_u²:u∈S∩T}; functional-single-target squares make UW coordinate again. Thus supports obey S1=V and S_k=∪_{a+b=k}σ(S_a∩S_b). Induction over incoming maximum path depth d: sources have only k=1; for target at depth d, some predecessor has depth d−1 and for every 2≤k≤2^d one can split k=a+b with 1≤a,b≤2^(d−1) giving membership; conversely any producing predecessor has depth≤d−1 so k≤2^d. This proves full filtration and terminal 2^L+1, independent of coefficients/characteristic. Independent branching/merging example f=(2,2,3,None) yielded S1={0,1,2,3}, S2={2,3}, S3=S4={3}, S5=empty; sampled graph is not infinite proof.
